propositions: Project-specific code-review criteria configured via overlay merge successfully but never execute, creating a silent failure indistinguishable from a rubric finding no issues.
The code-review runtime currently executes only static workflow lists and packaged decision/eval lookups, lacking the project-criteria extension surface promised by ADR 0017.
Project criteria must run exactly once per review through a stateless fan-in discriminator during round_a, with logical-to-physical prompt id mapping and repository-effective routing in Pass 3.
Activated missing or malformed project prompt/eval assets must raise a fatal located LLMError before model execution rather than silently skipping or emitting empty findings.
The criteria eval CLI must accept logical code-review project ids, resolve them to physical prompt ids, and reject ambiguous or inactive ids with explicit errors.
